analysis: Batch 1 Step 4 strain-to-species collapse and pathway-root classification
method: Retained edges are grouped by target, donor species, precursor, and recipient species. A relationship is single_root when at least one linked retained recipient path has exactly one non-currency extracellular root and that root is the focal precursor; otherwise it is multi_root. If both path types occur, the relationship is classified as single_root and single-root paths define its primary support.
interpretation_boundary: Strain disagreement is preserved through exact GEM and model-pair numerators and manifest-based denominators. Multi-root relationships are not assigned to complete Case 2A/2B community suppliers.
